data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal sprite strip of 6 frames for the Codex app digital pet named 'tracebun' in the 'review' state. Use the attached canonical base pet/reference as identity lock. Preserve the exact pet design, palette, outline weight, proportions, face, markings, tiny chest service badge, floppy ears, and overall silhouette. Only vary pose/action subtly across frames to make a readable review animation cycle; keep the pet centered, fully visible, and entirely inside each frame with no cropping or crossing frame boundaries. 

Important output requirements: the entire canvas must be a perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF background edge to edge. No white, off-white, gray, checkerboard, guide boxes, dividers, borders, labels, slot lines, or any layout artifacts. Do not include any background details besides the flat magenta. 

Match the attached layout guide only for spacing and frame count mentally, then ignore it visually. Arrange exactly 6 separate frames left-to-right in one row. Each frame should show the same compact observability guardian rabbit with warm brown and cream colors, sturdy chibi silhouette, thick dark outline, calm focused eyes, small floppy ears, tiny service badge on the chest, and reliable engineer energy. Use subtle animation poses appropriate for 'review' such as slight head tilt, small ear shifts, gentle blink, tiny hand movement, and minimal body bobbing while keeping identity unchanged. Sprite style: clean pixel-art / digital pet sprite, crisp edges, readable at small size, no high-res rendering.
